# Oldest end sweep

`customer_support.pb.queue_management.oldest_end_sweep` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> Run a standing pass over the oldest end of the queue as a separate assignment, given to someone who is not simultaneously measured on volume that shift.

Anything that competes with throughput loses to throughput. Aged tickets are slow, context has been lost, and the customer is already unhappy — an agent choosing rationally will never pick one. The tail only gets worked when working the tail is somebody's actual job for the day.
